opportunities.title: The building blocks for a voice assistant exist
opportunities.detail: Commercial speech recognition and a synthetic voice both exist, but no major assistant understands spoken requests in this language yet.
opportunities.why: About 42 million Swahili speakers are online today, and that should reach 63 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (40 hours of transcribed speech); FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: The interface is translated on 1 of 3 major platforms
opportunities.detail: People can already use some phone and computer platforms in this language. Shared terminology would make the remaining ones faster to translate.
opportunities.why: About 30 million Swahili speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 45 million within five years. Ready to use: Unicode CLDR (modern coverage).

opportunities.title: Text recognition is offered by 2 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: Some services already read printed text in this language, and an open OCR model covers it.
opportunities.why: About 30 million Swahili speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 45 million within five years. Ready to use: Tesseract OCR (covers this language); FineWeb-2 (574 million words).

opportunities.title: Speech recognition makes about 34 errors per 100 words
opportunities.detail: Measured on FLEURS with a leading open model. Below about 15% is comfortably usable for dictation.
opportunities.why: About 42 million Swahili speakers are online today, and that should reach 63 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (40 hours of transcribed speech); FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: 1 of 2 major AI assistant apps list this language
opportunities.detail: Some assistant apps already offer it. Benchmarks show models can work in it, so the gap is mainly a product decision.
opportunities.why: About 30 million Swahili speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 45 million within five years. Ready to use: Belebele (covers this language); FLORES-200 (covers this language).

opportunities.title: Predictive text and autocorrect could be built from open text
opportunities.detail: The iOS keyboard has 0 of 4 typing features. FineWeb-2 holds about 574 million words of openly licensed web text, enough to train word prediction.
opportunities.why: About 30 million Swahili speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 45 million within five years. Ready to use: FineWeb-2 (574 million words); Wikipedia (133 thousand articles).
